title: Brand mark · International mark lock-up options
slide_intent: Teach designers to select the arrangement that fits the available reading axis. The mark should stay identifiable in a narrow column, wide strip or web header.
strategic_value: A small set of prepared variants can accommodate different surfaces while keeping the symbol and logotype related.
demonstration: A print grid compares two-line, single-line and centered marks. An online row places the symbol to the left of the lettering.
practical_value: Use the standard two-line version for a restricted print space, the centered one on a central axis, and the web version for top-left navigation.

content_islands.spec: Group the left-hand explanations under the names of the four lockups.

content_islands.name: Print comparisons
content_islands.spec: Under a cyan print label, stack the two horizontal specimens and put the centered specimen beside them.
